title: Upload the official character sheets and set them as absolute references to…
content:
Upload the official character sheets and set them as absolute references to prioritize character consistency (never redesign/reinterpret/replace/merge characters).

Lock the cast to exactly four official members (Sakura, Tsuki, Mochi, An) and forbid any new characters.

Set the video length to 15 seconds and the aspect ratio to 9:16 for this episode.

Maintain continuity by keeping the same stage, background, and lighting style from the previous episode; do not change locations.

Start the clip by matching the exact close-up from the end of the previous episode, hold ~0.2s, then immediately pull back into the performance.

Direct the performance with natural smiles, eye contact, elegant choreography, dynamic upper-body moves, and include one brief synchronized hero pose.

Avoid repeated framing by specifying varied shots and fast rhythm editing.

Specify camera moves explicitly (push in, pull out, side tracking, orbit camera, shoulder cam, crash zoom, lens compression) and instruct the camera to follow the emotion.

Keep lighting consistent with a luxury concert look: same LED wall, same color palette, warm spotlight, premium atmosphere.

End by having the four members gather, gently push in, let Sakura step slightly forward, finish on Sakura close-up, and hold ~0.2s.

Add negative constraints to preserve a clean output: no text, no subtitles, no logo, no watermark.
